title: Evaluation of Polyomavirus BK infection in oncogenic patients
author: Kariminik, A.
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect CSF specimens
steps.instruction: Obtain 120 cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) specimens from hospitalized oncogenic patients for BK polyomavirus screening.

steps.title: Perform PCR for BK DNA
steps.instruction: Run a polymerase chain reaction (PCR) on each CSF sample using BK polyomavirus‑specific primers to amplify viral DNA.

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR products on a 2 % agarose gel by electrophoresis.

steps.title: Detect 173 bp band
steps.instruction: Visualize the gel; the appearance of a 173‑base‑pair band indicates a positive BK polyomavirus result.

steps.title: Record positivity rate
steps.instruction: Count the number of positive samples; four patients (3.33 % of the 120 specimens) showed the 173‑bp band.
